# Lead Guitar

Lead guitar lessons may involve bends, vibrato, phrasing, timing, articulation, picking, fretboard navigation, improvisation, and learning solos or smaller phrases directly from recordings.

Knowing which notes to play is only half of the story. We can spend time looking at how different guitarists actually produce those notes and what makes their playing recognizable.

Over time, learning ideas from several different players can help you add licks to your back pocket to experiment with and eventually combine in your own way.

**This path is a starting point, not a fixed curriculum.**
